ShortDescription.Value: Reduce taxi traffic and Cim use in the city.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Taxi Traffic [BETA] Citizens make smarter travel choices by reducing taxi use.
### What it does - ✅ Prevents most cims from choosing taxis - ✅ Optional: include/exclude **Commuters** and **Tourists**
### What to expect - Fewer taxi trips after a short adjustment period. - Existing taxis may still be visible briefly (finishing previous behavior), then taxi traffic declines. - Can be enabled/disabled in Options menu. - To disable: set "Citizens allowed to use taxis" to 100% (resets to game defaults); stops applying ignore taxi restrictions.
### Safety / compatibility - Safe to remove anytime. - No Harmony based patching; less likely to break on game patch day. - Tip: If you want to verify usage, check Options menu > mod Status, see if usage is going down after a city runs a little.
### Support and Feedback - Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). - Submit feedback using the Github or Discord icon links (right side of page). PR's are welcome.
### Credits and Thanks - RiverMochi: mod author - Noel/Noel2 (of MapExt): testing, feedback - Thumbnail: Wikipedia Traffic Congestion, photo by joiseyshowaa from Freehold, NJ - World Class Traffic Jam 2, license CC BY-SA 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=63542844
### How it works - Applies the game's own vanilla IgnoreTaxi flags which is easier and safer. Research shows using a heavy hammered disable of the complex taxi system creates scary frozen citizen zombies (before you ask, no we don't want that).
